content_variants.text:
Two martyrs in Rif Dimashq | Israel targets military positions in Al-Suwaydaa and Damascus

Israel fired several missiles on military positions of the Iranain militias and centres of the regime’s Air-Defence in several areas, where an Israeli missile hit Radar Tel Al-Sahn area of the regime in eastern of Lahoya village in Al-Suwaydaa countryside.

Moreover, a missile hit the glass laboratory in Al-Kaswa area in Rif Dimashq, leading to the death of at least two civilians.

A few hours ago, Israeli missiles were fired on the area of the Damascus International Airport, an Iranian position near the area of Al-Saida Zainab and Al-Ma’amil (laboratories) area in Al-Kaswa, while missiles of the Syrian Air-Defence were fired to block them and managed to block at least two missiles.

Violent explosions were heard in the area of Qasiyon Mountain and Al-Saida Zainab area, which is believed to be due to missiles of the regime’s Air-Defence, while ambulance vehicles rushed to the targeted areas.

It is worth noting that Israel has targeted Syrian territory ten times since the beginning of 2023.
